Dr Dog at Middle East, Upstairs

with Ms

  • Mar 27, 2006
  • Cambridge, Massachusetts

A highlight memory of the early days of moving to Boston. A very small show with a Philly band my crew was just getting into. They played their entire first LP and had a singalong to the final track ‘Wake up,’ inviting fans on the little stage.


This show happened during an era when I was experimenting with illustrating photos via adobe illustrator. I gave both the singers the pen-tool treatment based on the above photos.
